```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 300
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, ggplot2, dplyr, scales
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
# Load PSA cache for Model B (focused)
cache_file <- here("data", "tidy", "psa_obj_focused.rds")

if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  psa_obj <- readRDS(cache_file)
  cat("Loaded PSA cache for Model B (focused):",
      psa_obj$n_sim, "iterations,",
      length(psa_obj$strategies), "strategies\n")
  psa_available <- TRUE
} else {
  warning("PSA cache not found: ", cache_file,
          "\nPlease run script 12_PSA.R first.")
  psa_available <- FALSE
}
```

```{r build-incremental-data, include=FALSE}
scatter_data <- data.frame()

if (psa_available) {
  cost_df <- as.data.frame(psa_obj$cost)
  effect_df <- as.data.frame(psa_obj$effect)

  # Compute incremental cost and effect relative to control
  for (strategy in setdiff(psa_obj$strategies, "control")) {
    inc_df <- data.frame(
      inc_effect = effect_df[[strategy]] - effect_df[["control"]],
      inc_cost = cost_df[[strategy]] - cost_df[["control"]],
      Strategy = strategy,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    scatter_data <- rbind(scatter_data, inc_df)
  }

  # Strategy labels
  strategy_labels <- c(
    "crp" = "CRP Strategy",
    "tlr" = "TLR Strategy",
    "tmb_braf" = "TMB/BRAF Strategy"
  )

  scatter_data$Strategy <- factor(
    scatter_data$Strategy,
    levels = names(strategy_labels),
    labels = strategy_labels
  )
}
```

```{r create-ce-plane, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
if (nrow(scatter_data) > 0) {
  strategy_colors <- c(
    "CRP Strategy" = "#E69F00",
    "TLR Strategy" = "#009E73",
    "TMB/BRAF Strategy" = "#0072B2"
  )

  WTP <- 51000

  p_ce <- ggplot(scatter_data, aes(x = inc_effect, y = inc_cost, color = Strategy)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.5) +
    # WTP threshold line (y = WTP * x)
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = WTP, linetype = "dashed",
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    # Origin reference lines
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "\u20AC", big.mark = ",")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = strategy_colors, name = "Strategy") +
    labs(
      x = "Incremental Effectiveness (QALYs)",
      y = "Incremental Cost (EUR)"
    ) +
    # WTP label
    annotate("text",
      x = max(scatter_data$inc_effect, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.65,
      y = max(scatter_data$inc_effect, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.65 * WTP,
      label = paste0("WTP = \u20AC", format(WTP, big.mark = ","), "/QALY"),
      size = 3.2, hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5, color = "black"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3), nrow = 1))

  print(p_ce)
} else {
  cat("PSA results not available. Please run script 12_PSA.R first.\n")
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(scatter_data) > 0) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) {
    dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = here("figs", "figure3.png"),
    plot = p_ce,
    width = 9,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "figure3.png"), "\n")
}
```

Figure 3 has been saved to `figs/figure3.png`.
